name: codex-memory-hub
description: Codex memory plugin for clean, restartable, parallel project work.

interface.shortDescription: Clean thread and workstream memory for Codex work.
interface.longDescription: Initializes a clean Codex memory layout for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The project root keeps only AGENTS.md while all memory data lives under .codex-memory with per-thread logs, workstream coordination, and archive folders.
defaultPrompt: Initialize Codex Memory Hub for this project.
Create a new thread memory or workstream for this task.
